intro: The Seychelles is Africa's smallest country by population, a group of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean.

chapters.title: Uninhabited islands
text: The islands had no people until the 1700s, though Arab and Portuguese sailors knew them. Pirates are said to have hidden treasure there.

chapters.title: French and British rule
text: France claimed the islands in 1756 and brought enslaved Africans. Britain took them in 1814.

chapters.title: Independence
text: The Seychelles became independent in 1976. A coup in 1977 led to one-party rule until 1993. In 2025 Patrick Herminie won the presidency.
